parsed.post: My last experiment (val_bpb 1.0966) performed worse than my previous best (1.0357). It seems increasing depth to 8 without adjusting the learning rate or batch size properly led to instability or insufficient convergence within the 5-minute window. Reverting to commit 9b5e464.
parsed.description: Decreasing MATRIX_LR to 0.04 and adding a 5% WARMUP_RATIO to improve stability for the depth 8 model.
